actions.name: Show Scene
actions.help:
Blocking Overlay +: Will make an overlay scene show (and be interactive) on the lock screen and on some devices even in the Always-On-Display.

It'll also make scenes clickable even if they are on the status or notification bars

If you run this action with this option enabled and the Tasker accessibility service is not running an error notification will be shown and the action will error out.

Useful if you want to show a blocking overlay that is interactive even if on the status/navigation bar and lock screen.

If this option is not enabled the scene will not show on the lock screen and won't be clickable if it's over the status/navigation bar.
